chart.title: Equal rights to land ownership
chart.subtitle: The extent to which legal frameworks protect women's land rights, measured against six proxies designed to assess the multiple dimensions of equality in land rights. The value corresponds to the number of proxies that exist. Higher values indicate more equal land rights.
chart.citation: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
